scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit orbit-compatibility graphs and previously known ordinary cyclic Rips homotopy; finite software verifies representative instances.
scientific_limitations: Geometric fixed spaces of individual dihedral elements for inclusive cyclic graph Rips complexes at the first critical n=3r boundary, r>=2. Ordinary sphere-wedge type is prior work. No all-subgroup equivariant classification or integral representation splitting.
title: Geometric dihedral fixed spaces at the first critical cyclic Rips scale
